title: Seed fundraising
goal: Show the founder workstreams required to prepare and run a seed fundraising process.

rubric.must: Seed Fundraising is visibly the central root of the map.
Narrative, Materials, Investor Process, and Company Readiness visibly branch from the central topic.
Materials visibly expands to Pitch deck and Data room with concrete deliverables beneath them.
Investor Process visibly expands to Target list and Meetings with thesis-fit and partner-diligence details.
Company Readiness visibly expands to Metrics and Legal with named evidence items.
At least three visual levels are distinguishable from root to detailed leaves.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the mindmap/map exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The drawing visibly presents Seed Fundraising as the central root and includes all four required workstreams, their specified subtopics, and detailed leaf items across three distinguishable hierarchy levels.

items.evidence: Seed Fundraising appears prominently in the central dark rounded node.
Narrative, Materials, Investor Process, and Company Readiness visibly branch from the central node.
Materials expands to Pitch deck and Data room; Product demo and Financial model appear beneath them, respectively.
Investor Process expands to Target list and Meetings, with Thesis fit and Partner diligence as their visible details.
Company Readiness expands to Metrics and Legal, with Growth and retention and Cap table and terms as named evidence items.
The map clearly distinguishes at least three levels: central root, colored workstream nodes, subtopics, and terminal detail leaves.
